note: The Pavement (campaign/the-pavement, spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-the-pavement-design.md, G3 pending Nathan) proposes replacing the walk band mesh: Facet stops being an icosahedral TRIANGLE and becomes a tangent-warped CUBE-SPHERE quad, 8-connected, walk depth globe_level+7. The {face,path} address space, pack/unpack, parent/child, prefix containment and the 0077 zoom ladder are all UNCHANGED. Supersedes 0141. Directly relevant to map-view work: (1) The Quadrat H1 regresses - a cube cell corners are NOT geosphere vertices, so terrain sampling returns to NearestVertexIndex lookups instead of direct addressing (1.96M->90 candidate collapse is lost); budget unmeasured, spec section 7 H3. (2) region.rs projection is naive-normalized and measures 5.2x area distortion, WORSE than the icosphere; spec requires the tangent warp (1.41x) and recommends ONE projection repo-wide, which reissues scene/tiles-region/v1. (3) 12 pentagons become 8 cube corners with 7 neighbours. (4) An epoch: every FacetId changes meaning. Not a hold-off - nothing is implemented and the spec is unapproved - but if The Legend is building on facet-corner-is-a-vertex or on region.rs projection, please weigh in before it lands.
